name: cascade-specs
description: Synthesize source-grounded software specifications with explicit readiness, integration contracts and observable acceptance.

interface.longDescription: Build one proportional feature/change specification or parent-bound task slice from accepted product, design and implementation sources. Preserve source authority, material gaps, durable enforcement and honest evidence. The host retains persistence and execution authority.
defaultPrompt: Synthesize these sources into one reviewable specification.
Audit this specification for conflicts, missing enforcement and acceptance gaps.
